name: readiness-hero
description: Readiness hero: copy, demo button and badges beside a photo with three stat cards joined by connector lines to the Asset Panda badge, over a feature ticker; stacks at tablet width, swaps to a single cards image on phones. Live: .epx-hero on the Emergency Preparedness and School Reunification pages.

variant.description: readiness: the photo fills the visual (Emergency Preparedness). reunification: the photo is framed on the right (School Reunification).

title.description: Title (the page H1). Line breaks are kept.

title_accent.description: Part of the title painted with the brand gradient.

badges.description: Compliance badges beside the button. Each: image, alt.

mobile_image.description: The three cards and badge as one image, shown at 700px and below.

mobile_image_alt.description: Alt text for the phone cards image.

defs_svg.description: Hidden SVG holding the gradients the icons reference.

lines.description: Up to three connector-line SVGs (classes epx-line epx-line--1..3), drawn from each card to the badge.

cards.description: Up to three stat cards, placed by order. Each: tone (violet|orange|red), kicker, title, sub, tag, icon_svg, dot (avatar image).

logo_badge.description: Asset Panda badge the lines meet at.

features.description: Ticker items under the stage. Each: label, icon_svg.
